description:
Rosemary (Salvia rosmarinus) is a fragrant herb that is completely safe for cats. Many people grow it indoors or in gardens because it is easy to care for and smells wonderful.

Interestingly, many cats don't like the strong, woody scent of rosemary. Because of this, your cat will likely ignore the plant or choose not to chew on it.

If your cat does happen to take a nibble, there is no need to worry. It is non-toxic and won't cause any harm. It's a great choice for adding some greenery to your home without risking your cat's health.
name: Rosemary
